angle_hi: अर्जुन का शस्त्र त्यागकर निहत्थे मर जाना

en.intro: Arjuna looks at the armed Kaurava army and asks if it would be better to die unresisting than to raise his own weapon against his kin.
en.notice: Arjuna says it would be better to be killed unresisting and unarmed than to fight back against Dhritarashtra's sons, revealing his absolute refusal to defend himself.
en.next: Sanjaya then reports that Arjuna sat down on the chariot, dropped his weapons, and gave way to grief.
en.meaning: If the armed sons of Dhritarashtra were to kill me in battle while I stood unresisting and without weapons, that would be far better for me.

hi.intro: अर्जुन हथियारबंद कौरव सेना को देखते हैं और पूछते हैं कि क्या निहत्थे और बिना विरोध किए मर जाना अपनों पर हथियार उठाने से बेहतर होगा।
hi.meaning: अगर हथियार लिए हुए धृतराष्ट्र के पक्ष के लोग युद्ध में मुझ निहत्थे और सामना न करने वाले को मार भी दें, तो वह मेरे लिए अधिक कल्याणकारी होगा।
hi.notice: अर्जुन कहते हैं कि अगर हथियार लिए हुए धृतराष्ट्र के पक्ष के लोग युद्ध में मुझ निहत्थे और सामना न करने वाले को मार भी दें, तो वह मेरे लिए अधिक कल्याणकारी होगा। यह उनके मन की स्थिति को दर्शाता है।
hi.next: संजय बताते हैं कि यह कहकर अर्जुन रथ पर बैठ गए, शस्त्र त्याग दिए और शोक में डूब गए।

en.intro: Arjuna looks at the armed Kaurava army and asks if it would be better to die unresisting than to raise his own weapon against his kin.
en.body: If the armed sons of Dhritarashtra were to kill me in battle while I stood unresisting and without weapons, that would be far better for me. Arjuna says it would be better to be killed unresisting and unarmed than to fight back against Dhritarashtra's sons, revealing his absolute refusal to defend himself. Sanjaya then reports that Arjuna sat down on the chariot, dropped his weapons, and gave way to grief.
